description: Check whether a name is taken as a trademark in the US, EU and Israeli registers. Returns one of three verdicts (exact_live_mark, similar_live_marks, no_live_match), or not_checked when no register in the check has been read yet, with the marks behind it, how each matched, and when each register was read.

classes.description: Nice classes to check against, when known.

goods.description: What will be sold, in a few words; mapped to Nice classes.

name.description: The business or product name to check.

registers.description: A subset of the registers; all three by default.

name: check_trademark
title: Check a trademark
